overlapPolicies.notes: Dated-range overlap for closed assignments is not excluded at PostgreSQL; adapters must close prior rows before creating overlapping dated ranges.
Overlap of successive governing contracts is command-enforced only; no btree_gist exclusion constraint in this migration.
Secondary and dotted-line relationship_kind values may overlap by design; only primary lines are overlap-guarded.
